text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rich Demi-Cheese Carrot Burger... Today, I 
will conquer it without spilling a single 
drop.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The greatest adversary is the demi-glace 
sauce. Once, I challenged it without a 
plan and was defeated, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes... This time is different. By shifting 
the center of gravity of the solid 
ingredients downward, and gripping the 
bottom bun firmly...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheheh... A flawless 
calculation... An impregnable defense no 
matter where you take a bite from―

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to enjoy her food properly because 
of the headache, she ended up feeling 
terribly down...
